title: Measure closed-stdin task binding and re-check the carried-over 0.80.6 findings
statement: Confirm a `--mode json -p --no-session` child with closed stdin can receive its exact task through the supported non-stdin channel, with an observation taken at the child. Re-run the five behaviours recorded against 0.80.6 — silent untrusted load, trust store shape, skill override precedence, default active tool set, turn-end hooks in a non-interactive child — and record which still hold. Answers QST-0030 and QST-0031.
